units.text: A 2025 Oregon publication measured Mount Hood at 11,249 feet above sea level. Evidence 4df58c35-46d1-4651-9cee-7078c2b6e901 confirms a 2025 USGS OnDemand Topo page for Mount Hood in Oregon with elevation label 11,249 ft, establishing the publication year and value. Evidence 9e97e006-4157-4c27-9283-2

judgement.reason: The passages support a 2025 USGS OnDemand Topo page for Mount Hood, Oregon, but do not mention 11,249 feet or any elevation value.

units.text: The assertion that a 2025 Oregon publication measured Mount Hood at 11,249 feet is contradicted by a 1993 Seattle Times article (evidence 66be439c-0c91-4a29-8299-a7624941b84c) reporting 11,240 feet as the measured elevation. The claim's timeframe and measurement value are not supported by that 1993.

citations.title: Mount Hood Gains Or Loses In Latest Height Measurement | The Seattle Times

judgement.reason: The passage confirms the 1993 Seattle Times reported Mount Hood's elevation as 11,240 feet, but it does not mention any 2025 Oregon publication or an 11,249-foot measurement, so the contradiction claim is only partly established.

units.text: Wikipedia (evidence 4978b5e2-ede6-4521-b75d-a5dfd39a2863) states Mount Hood's summit elevation is 11,249 ft NAVD 88 but does not state a 2025 publication date, and other sources cite different measurement years (1991 NGVD, 1993 survey, 1916 Coast and Geodetic Survey).

judgement.reason: The passages confirm Mount Hood's summit elevation as 11,249 ft NAVD 88 and mention a 1993 survey, and they do not state a 2025 publication date. However, they say the 1991 entry used NAVD 88, not NGVD, and they do not mention a 1916 Coast and Geodetic Survey.
